New Music Coming Soon

10 January 2026

New Sounds on the Horizon

I’ve been working hard in the studio over the past few months, and I’m thrilled to share that new music is on its way. The creative process has been an incredible journey of exploration and discovery.

What to Expect

This new material represents a natural evolution of my sound while staying true to the atmospheric textures that define my work. Expect:

  • Lush, layered soundscapes
  • Intricate rhythmic patterns
  • Melodic hooks that stay with you
  • A blend of organic and electronic elements

The Recording Process

Working with some amazing collaborators has pushed me to try new approaches. From late-night sessions experimenting with unconventional recording techniques to meticulous mixing sessions, every step has been about capturing something authentic.

Stay Tuned

More details will be coming soon, including release dates and previews. In the meantime, you can listen to “Never There” right here on the site using the audio player.

Thank you for your continued support. There’s much more to come.
